snippet.title: Bigger Picture Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The Bigger Picture is a puzzle platformer where your only goal is to press all the buttons to expand your view, allowing you to see 'the bigger picture'. This is the first official game released by LemonCaitie. 

The Bigger Picture Demo is out now! Wishlist it on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851500/The_Bigger_Picture/
